usersPage.title: User Management
usersPage.description: System-wide account list — look up, update profiles, lock/unlock. Accounts are created from HR Management / Student Management.
usersPage.loadError: Failed to load the account list.

search.placeholder: Search by username / email / full name...

empty.title: No matching accounts found
empty.description: Try broadening your keyword or filters.

detail.hint: Department / attendance exemption belong to the HR profile — edit them in "HR Management", not here.

profile.sectionDescription: Only changes this account's displayed full name/phone number.

email.sectionDescription: Use this when the current email is just a placeholder (auto-created Student/Parent account) — switch to a real Google email so Google sign-in (UC-01) can match it.

password.sectionDescription: Admin sets a new password directly for this account, effective immediately — no need to know the old password (use when a user forgets their password).
password.validationError: The new password must be at least 8 characters.
password.confirmMessage: Confirm setting a new password for account "{{username}}"? This account can log in immediately with the new password; the old password will no longer work.

status.sectionDescription: Change the account's login status — deactivating/suspending blocks login immediately.

loginHistory.sectionDescription: Every login (successful and failed) with device info reported by the browser.

accountSelector.passwordPlaceholder: Leave blank for Google sign-in only (min. 8 characters if entered)
accountSelector.searchPlaceholder: Search by email / username / full name...

userSearchCombobox.defaultPlaceholder: Click to browse the list or type to search...
userSearchCombobox.truncatedHint: More accounts available — type to narrow the results.
